b:if.title: | KriTere

div.h1: Fun & clever board games for the whole family
div.p: KriTere.com, named after two sisters, KrisAnn and Terez, brings you two family-friendly, educational and fun board games: Don't Get Mad! and Kris Ann's Journey. Play on PC, in your web browser or on Android.
Watch the trailers, then play in your browser, on Windows PC or on Android.

button.aria-label: Play the Don't Get Mad! trailer

div.p: The hand-drawn family board game
Don't Get Mad! started on paper: father and daughter drew this colorful board game by hand, complete with every square and story.
They had so much fun playing it together that they decided to share it with everyone in electronic form. Perfect for a game night with family and friends!
Posters & screenshots

button.aria-label: Play the Kris Ann's Journey trailer

div.p: Strategy board game + trivia quiz
Kris Ann's Journey (KAJ) is a strategy board game and trivia quiz in one!
Travel the world, answer quiz questions and make smart tactical choices to score points. Learn something new every time you play.
Posters & screenshots

div.h2: Safe, smart and made with love
div.p: Games we would happily give to our own kids, because we did.
No ads, no in-app purchases and no accounts required. Just open and play.
Intelligent and educational: quiz questions, world travel and smart tactical choices.
Both games work fully offline in the apps, perfect for trips and holidays.
2 to 4 players around one device, or challenge the AI robots on your own.

div.h2: Named after two sisters, KrisAnn & Terez
div.p: KriTere.com is a family project. Our games are made by a family, for families: bright, fair and full of little stories.
Both games are ideal for a fun game night with family and friends, with 2 to 4 players or AI robots when you want to play on your own.

figure.blockquote: “Father and daughter drew Don't Get Mad! by hand on paper, every square and every story. It was so much fun, we had to share it with everyone.”

details.summary: Do the games have ads or in-app purchases?
details.p: No. Don't Get Mad! and Kris Ann's Journey have no ads, no in-app purchases and need no account.
Yes. Both games work fully offline in the Windows PC and Android apps. The web version runs right in your browser.
2 to 4 players can play together on one device, or you can challenge the AI robots.
Windows PC (Microsoft Store), Android (Google Play) and any modern web browser.
KriTere is named after two sisters, KrisAnn and Terez.
